# Certificate: for the twist g = s_r, r = (e0+e1+e2+e3+e4+e5+e6-e7)/2, the Z-span S of all
# products u *_g v (u, v in Lambda) is all of Lambda.  Generated by run_02_witnesses.g (GAP 4.12.1).
#
# Conventions: coordinates w.r.t. e0..e7 per block; R^24 = blocks (x,y,z).
# ALL VECTORS ARE GIVEN IN DOUBLED COORDINATES (2*v), so every entry is an integer.
# Octonion product: Fano triples (1,2,4),(2,3,5),(3,4,6),(4,5,7),(5,6,1),(6,7,2),(7,1,3);
#   e_a e_b = e_c cyclically, anticyclic negative, e_i^2 = -e0, e0 = identity.
# Twist: g(x) = x - <x,r> r (a reflection, g = g^{-1}); x ._g y = g^{-1}(g(x) . g(y)).
# Triple product: P1 = x.x'+z.y'+y.z', P2 = y.y'+x.z'+z.x', P3 = z.z'+y.x'+x.y' (all ._g).
# Lambda: (x,y,z) in L^3 with x+y, x+z, y+z in L sbar and x+y+z in L s; L = D8+ (integer
#   coordinates with even sum, or half-integer coordinates with odd sum); L s = {l.s : l in L},
#   L sbar = {l.sbar : l in L}, s = (-e0+e1+...+e7)/2, sbar = (-e0-e1-...-e7)/2.
#
# How to check:
#  (i)   each BASIS row lies in Lambda and det Gram(BASIS) = 2^24 = covolume(Lambda)^2, so BASIS
#        is a Z-basis of Lambda;
#  (ii)  closure: all 576 products BASIS[a] *_g BASIS[c] lie in Lambda (so S <= Lambda);
#  (iii) the 24 products listed under A lie in Lambda and det Gram(A) = 2^24 * DET_A^2, so
#        span(A) has index |DET_A| = 2^44 in Lambda and 2^44 * Lambda <= S;
#  (iv)  likewise for B with |DET_B| odd, so DET_B * Lambda <= S;
#  (v)   gcd(DET_A, DET_B) = 1, so Lambda <= S.  With (ii): S = Lambda.
#
r2 = [ 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, -1 ]
